## HIGH IMPACT

No confirmed HIGH impact items can be identified from the provided diff alone. The six files listed as changed (`ha-card.ts`, `ha-icon-arrow-next.ts`, `ha-icon-arrow-prev.ts`, `ha-icon-button-first.ts`, `ha-icon-button-last.ts`, `ha-icon.ts`) are all shown as binary/empty diffs, meaning no structural source change is visible in the provided data. However, two changes described in the release notes warrant close inspection as **potentially breaking** pending source diff review:

### Component: `hui-heading-card` (heading-card)

**What changed:** PR #54068 "Use heading elements for heading-card" — the card now renders semantic `<h1>`/`<h2>`/etc. heading elements instead of its previous non-semantic markup for the card title.

**LCARS rules affected:** The `card-mod-card-yaml` CSS in `preamble.yaml` explicitly targets `h1` in multiple selectors:
```css
> :not(style,card-mod,h1)          /* exclusion selector */
ha-card:has(ha-sortable) $ h1.card-header  /* todo-list header */
```
The exclusion `:not(style,card-mod,h1)` was written to prevent `<h1>` elements inside card headers from receiving the background-color resets applied to card content children. If the heading-card now wraps its title in a native `<h1>` that is a **direct child** of `ha-card`, this exclusion selector may interact differently than intended — either correctly excluding it (good) or exposing a case where the heading receives or doesn't receive the LCARS background color as expected.

**Suggested fix:** After updating, visually verify `hui-heading-card` instances in LCARS dashboards. If the heading text inherits an unwanted `background-color: var(--lcars-background-color)` from the `> :not(style,card-mod,h1)` rule or conversely misses the LCARS card-top coloring, add an explicit rule:
```css
> h1, > h2, > h3, > h4, > h5, > h6 {
  background-color: transparent;
  color: var(--lcars-card-top-text);
}
```

### Component: Chips migration (`ha-chip` → Web Awesome)

**What changed:** PR #54124 "Migrate chips from Material to Web Awesome" — the chip elements used throughout the UI (filter chips, entity chips in automation editors, etc.) have been migrated from Material Design (`md-chip`, `md-chip-set`) to Web Awesome (`wa-chip` or equivalent).

**LCARS rules affected:** The preamble's `card-mod-config-yaml` and `card-mod-card-yaml` set:
```css
--md-sys-color-primary: var(--lcars-ui-quaternary) !important;
```
This variable controlled chip background color in the Material chip system. Web Awesome chips use a different variable namespace (`--wa-*`). If chips appear in dashboards, config pages, or automation editors, they will fall back to HA defaults (typically a teal/primary color) rather than LCARS quaternary gray.

**Suggested fix:** Identify the Web Awesome chip variable for background color (likely `--wa-color-fill-*` or `--wa-chip-*`) and add to `&base` or the relevant `card-mod-*` sections:
```yaml
# In &base or card-mod-config-yaml :host block
wa-chip-background: var(--lcars-ui-quaternary)
# or as CSS:
--wa-color-fill-quiet-resting: var(--lcars-ui-quaternary);
```

### Component: More-info dialog — Related/Details split

**What changed:** PR #53920 "Split more-info related and details views" — the more-info dialog now has separate "related" and "details" views, which changes the internal DOM structure of the more-info sheet.

**LCARS rules affected:** `card-mod-more-info-yaml` targets:
```css
button.breadcrumb { font-family: var(--font-family); }
```
And the `:host` block sets `--lcars-primary-text`, `--card-background-color`, `--md-sys-color-surface`, etc. If the new views render in separate shadow roots or new component elements (e.g., a new `ha-more-info-details` or `ha-more-info-related` element), the existing `card-mod-more-info-yaml` injection may not reach them, leaving those views unstyled with HA defaults.

**Suggested fix:** After updating, open a more-info dialog and inspect the DOM to confirm whether the new detail/related views are in the same shadow root as before. If they are new custom elements, add card-mod rules targeting them explicitly:
```yaml
card-mod-more-info-yaml: |
  "ha-more-info-details $": |
    :host { /* mirror existing :host vars */ }
  "ha-more-info-related $": |
    :host { /* mirror existing :host vars */ }
```

## MEDIUM IMPACT

### Component: `ha-alert` spacing removal

**What changed:** PR #53799 "Remove the unnecessary spacing around the ha-alert components" — margins/padding around `<ha-alert>` elements have been removed globally.

**LCARS rules affected:** The `card-mod-config-yaml` and dashboard alert styles in the preamble target alert containers indirectly via `ha-card:has(ha-config-repairs)` and `ha-card:has(ha-config-updates)`. The removal of spacing means alert banners in config pages, the home dashboard alert section (`ha-config-dashboard`), and any inline alerts will now sit flush against adjacent content rather than having built-in breathing room.

**Suggested fix:** Add explicit margin to the LCARS alert container rules in `card-mod-config-yaml`:
```css
ha-card:has(ha-config-repairs),
ha-card:has(ha-config-updates) {
  margin-block: 8px; /* restore visual separation */
}
```

### Component: `ha-map` — New tile engine (MapLibre GL native)

**What changed:** PRs #54022, #54029, #54073, #54448 replace the Leaflet/CARTO map with a MapLibre GL native engine for the map panel and `ha-map` component. The map marker system was also redesigned (PR #54025, #54308).

**LCARS rules affected:** The preamble's `card-mod-root-yaml` injects no explicit map styling, and `card-mod-config-yaml` has no map panel rules. However, the LCARS `--lcars-background-color` (black) is set as `primary-background-color`, and the new MapLibre vector map has a new default style. PR #54489 "Fix ha-map crash when themes are not loaded yet" specifically mentions theme interaction. The map may render with incorrect contrast or color bleed against LCARS's black background, especially since the new style is light-colored by default.

**Suggested fix:** No LCARS CSS currently targets the map. If the map panel appears unstyled, add to `card-mod-config-yaml` or a new panel-specific rule:
```yaml
"ha-config-map $ ha-map $": |
  :host {
    --map-background: var(--lcars-background-color);
  }
```
Monitor whether the new `--ha-map-*` variables (if any) need LCARS values.

### Component: History timeline — Labels moved under bars

**What changed:** PRs #54086 and #54102 "Move history timeline names under the bars" — entity labels in the history timeline and history-graph card are now rendered below the bars instead of to the left. This changes the layout and likely the DOM structure of `hui-history-graph-card`.

**LCARS rules affected:** The preamble has no explicit `hui-history-graph-card` card-mod rules, so the visual impact is limited. However, since `card-mod-card-yaml` applies `--lcars-primary-text: var(--lcars-ui-quaternary-text)` to all card hosts, the newly repositioned labels will inherit this variable. The labels were previously in a different layout slot and may now be rendered in an element that previously received `--lcars-background-text` instead.

**Suggested fix:** Inspect the history-graph card after updating and verify label legibility. If labels appear in black text on a dark background (or white on light), add:
```css
:host(.type-history-graph) .timeline-label {
  color: var(--lcars-primary-text);
}
```

### Component: Digital clock card — New font-size variable

**What changed:** PR #53808 "Make digital clock card font size themeable" — a new CSS custom property was introduced to control the digital clock card's font size.

**LCARS rules affected:** The LCARS theme sets `header-font-size: calc(var(--header-height) * 0.93)` and `lcars-ui-app-header-clock` for the toolbar clock. If the new digital clock card variable inherits from `--ha-digital-clock-font-size` or similar, LCARS's custom font sizing may not apply to the card version of the clock.

**Suggested fix:** Identify the new variable name (likely `--ha-digital-clock-font-size` or `--digital-clock-font-size`) and add to `&base`:
```yaml
ha-digital-clock-font-size: var(--header-font-size)
```
This is low-risk to add preemptively.

### Component: User Settings page revamp

**What changed:** PR #52070 "Revamp user settings page & navigation" — the user profile/settings page has been significantly redesigned with new navigation structure.

**LCARS rules affected:** `card-mod-profile-yaml` targets:
```yaml
"ha-profile-section-general $ hass-tabs-subpage $": |
  div.bottom-bar { --header-height: 50px; }
"ha-profile-section-security $ hass-tabs-subpage $": |
  div.bottom-bar { --header-height: 50px; }
```
If the revamp renamed the profile sections (e.g., `ha-profile-section-general` → something else) or replaced `hass-tabs-subpage` with a new layout component, these rules will silently fail to apply, causing the bottom nav bar to use default height in the profile area.

**Suggested fix:** After updating, navigate to the user profile page and inspect the DOM to confirm `ha-profile-section-general` and `ha-profile-section-security` still exist. If renamed, update the card-mod selectors to match new element names.

### Component: Integration card redesign

**What changed:** PR #52828 "Redesign integration card and remove double navigation" — the integration card UI has been redesigned.

**LCARS rules affected:** `card-mod-config-yaml` targets `ha-config-integrations $ hass-tabs-subpage $` only for the bottom bar height. The card internals themselves may have changed their DOM structure, affecting how `--card-background-color: var(--lcars-settings-card-color)` propagates into integration cards.

**Suggested fix:** Verify integration card appearance after updating. If cards render with wrong background colors, inspect the new DOM structure and add targeted rules.

## LOW IMPACT

### Component: Select-slider card feature (new)

**What changed:** PR #53876 adds a new `hui-select-slider-feature` card feature for select/input_select tile controls. No LCARS styling currently targets this element.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed. Optionally add LCARS styling to match the color scheme if this feature is used in LCARS dashboards.

### Component: Target-humidity card feature — Buttons style (new)

**What changed:** PR #53901 "Add buttons style to target-humidity card feature" — new button style option for the humidity card feature.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed. The existing `--ha-ripple-color`, `--lcars-ripple-pressed-opacity`, and `--lcars-ripple-hover-opacity` variables from LCARS card-mod-card will apply to new buttons automatically via inheritance.

### Component: Timer UI enhancements

**What changed:** PR #53793 adds UI enhancements to the timer entity display.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed. The `card-mod-row-yaml` already handles `div.text-content` which covers timer rows.

### Component: Section strategies UI support

**What changed:** PR #54040 "Add UI support for section strategies" — new UI for configuring section view strategies.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed currently. If section strategy cards appear unstyled, LCARS `card-mod-card-yaml` will apply its standard card styling automatically.

### Component: Skeleton loading rows in data tables

**What changed:** PR #54328 "Show skeleton rows while data tables load" and PR #54325 "Add shared skeleton components" — skeleton placeholder rows are shown in data tables while loading.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed. Skeleton rows are transient and not visible to users for meaningful time. If LCARS-specific skeleton colors are desired, the new components can be targeted later.

### Component: New `ha-color-form-*` variables (already present in LCARS)

**What changed:** The LCARS theme already defines `ha-color-form-background`, `ha-color-form-background-hover`, `ha-color-form-background-disabled`, and `ha-color-fill-primary-quiet-resting` in `&base`. These continue to be valid.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed.

### Component: `ha-icon-arrow-next.ts` / `ha-icon-arrow-prev.ts` / `ha-icon-button-first.ts` / `ha-icon-button-last.ts`

**What changed:** These files appear in the diff as empty/binary changes. They likely represent RTL arrow direction fixes (PRs #53771, #54117 "RTL chevron fixes" and "Various RTL fixes"). The LCARS theme does not explicitly target these icon button elements.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed for LTR LCARS deployments. RTL users may benefit from testing navigation arrows after this update.
